content:
name: PR Fast

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: pr-fast-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  workflow-governance:
    name: Fast PR / Workflow governance
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup declaration checker Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5.6.0
        with:
          python-version-file: policy-engine/.python-version

      - name: Install declaration checker dependencies
        run: |
          python3 -m venv "${RUNNER_TEMP}/ci-declarations"
          "${RUNNER_TEMP}/ci-declarations/bin/python" -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check PyYAML==6.0.3 packaging==25.0

      - name: Install actionlint
        id: actionlint
        run: |
          echo "bin=$(policy-engine/tools/ci/install_actionlint.sh)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Run actionlint
        run: |
          "${{ steps.actionlint.outputs.bin }}" -color

      - name: Review workflow policy
        run: python3 policy-engine/tools/ci/check_workflow_policy.py --repo-root . --summary .github/workflow-policy-summary.md

      - name: Check declared Python test targets
        run: python3 .github/scripts/check_declared_test_targets.py --repo-root .

      - name: Check declared Python versions
        run: '"${RUNNER_TEMP}/ci-declarations/bin/python" .github/scripts/check_python_versions.py --repo-root .'

      - name: Validate Phase 7 ratchet policy
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          PR_BODY: ${{ github.event.pull_request.body || '' }}
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import os

          Path("/tmp/pr-body.md").write_text(os.environ.get("PR_BODY", ""), encoding="utf-8")
          PY
          python3 policy-engine/tools/ci/check_phase7_ratchet.py \
            --repo-root . \
            --pr-body-file /tmp/pr-body.md \
            --base-ref "${BASE_SHA}" \
            --head-ref "${GITHUB_SHA}"

      - name: Upload workflow policy summary
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: workflow-policy-summary
          path: .github/workflow-policy-summary.md
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

  dependency-review:
    name: Fast PR / Dependency review
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2

      - name: Review changed dependencies
        uses: actions/dependency-review-action@2031cfc080254a8a887f58cffee85186f0e49e48 # v4.9.0
        with:
          fail-on-severity: high
          fail-on-scopes: runtime
          show-openssf-scorecard: true
          show-patched-versions: true

  schema-snapshots:
    name: Fast PR / Schema snapshots
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: policy-engine
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2

      - name: Setup Policy Engine Python
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-policy-engine-python
        with:
          profile: minimal

      - name: Check schema snapshots
        run: uv run --extra ml python tools/quality/diagnostics/gen_schema.py --check

  quality-and-unit:
    name: Fast PR / Python quality and unit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: policy-engine
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2

      - name: Setup Policy Engine Python
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-policy-engine-python
        with:
          profile: minimal

      - name: Enforce import policy
        run: uv run python tools/quality/lint/lint_imports.py --policy architecture/imports/policy.toml --exceptions architecture/imports/exceptions.toml

      - name: Check fail-closed package import gates
        run: uv run polisyos-tools validation check-package-import-gates --fail-closed

      - name: Check last-mile inventory baseline
        run: uv run python tools/quality/validation/repository_last_mile_inventory.py --json-output _build/.tmp/last-mile/inventory.json --check

      - name: Enforce Foundry purity
        run: uv run python -m tools.quality.lint.lint_foundry --repo-root .

      - name: Check Scientist state reads
        run: uv run python tools/quality/diagnostics/check_state_reads.py

      - name: Check Scientist node version bumps
        run: uv run python tools/quality/diagnostics/check_scientist_node_version_bump.py

      - name: Check scholar imports
        run: uv run python tools/quality/lint/check_scholar_imports.py

      - name: Check connector contracts
        run: uv run polisyos-tools connectors check-contracts --check

      - name: Check schemas pure-data closure
        run: |
          mkdir -p _build/.tmp/last-mile
          find schemas \( -name '*.py' -o -name '__pycache__' \) -print | tee _build/.tmp/last-mile/schemas-python-residue.txt
          test ! -s _build/.tmp/last-mile/schemas-python-residue.txt

      - name: Check Repository SOTA contract closeout
        run: uv run polisyos-tools workspace repository-sota-closeout --contract-only

      - name: Check extension example installability
        run: uv run polisyos-tools validation check-extension-examples

      - name: Check validator module-size budget
        run: uv run python tools/quality/validation/architecture_report_only_contracts.py --report module-size --json-output _build/.tmp/last-mile/module-size.json --fail-on-contract-errors

      - name: Check tool config split drift
        run: uv run polisyos-tools workspace tool-configs --check

      - name: Run fast unit suite
        run: uv run pytest -m "not integration and not benchmark" --ignore=tests/unit/runtime/http

  docs-quality:
    name: Fast PR / Docs quality
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: policy-engine
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Policy Engine Python
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-policy-engine-python
        with:
          profile: docs

      - name: Run path-aware docs drift gate
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
        run: uv run polisyos-tools validation check-docs-gate --repo-root . --base-ref "${BASE_REF}"

      - name: Run path-aware docs drift gate for push
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.before }}
        run: uv run polisyos-tools validation check-docs-gate --repo-root . --base-ref "${BASE_REF}"

      - name: Check docs freshness baseline
        run: uv run polisyos-tools validation check-docs-freshness-baseline

      - name: Check docs lifecycle gates
        run: uv run polisyos-tools validation check-docs-lifecycle

      - name: Check ADR thematic index freshness
        run: uv run python tools/quality/validation/generate_adr_index.py --check

      - name: Check tool config split drift
        run: uv run polisyos-tools workspace tool-configs --check

      - name: Build docs in strict mode
        run: uv run python -m mkdocs build --strict

      - name: Check public-surface docstring quality
        run: uv run python tools/quality/validation/check_docstring_quality.py --repo-root . --allowlist tools/quality/validation/docstring_quality_allowlist.txt --coverage-scope public-surface --minimum-coverage 85

  abi-check:
    name: Fast PR / ABI drift
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: policy-engine
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup ripgrep
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-ripgrep

      - name: Report directly changed ABI paths
        id: abi_scope
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git diff --name-only "${BASE_SHA}" "${GITHUB_SHA}" > /tmp/changed-files.txt
          scan_status=0
          rg -q \
            '^(policy-engine/src/polisyos/ir/|policy-engine/src/polisyos/fabric/world/|policy-engine/src/polisyos/core/canon/|policy-engine/src/polisyos/core/artifacts/|policy-engine/schemas/|policy-engine/tools/quality/diagnostics/gen_schema.py|policy-engine/tools/quality/diagnostics/abi_diff.py|\\.github/workflows/abi.yml)' \
            /tmp/changed-files.txt || scan_status=$?
          if [[ "${scan_status}" -eq 0 ]]; then
            echo "changed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif [[ "${scan_status}" -eq 1 ]]; then
            echo "changed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "::error::ABI scan failed: rg (ripgrep) returned ${scan_status}." >&2
            exit "${scan_status}"
          fi
          echo "Direct ABI path scan: $(cat "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"). Snapshot validation runs for every pull request, including changes to imported models." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Setup Policy Engine Python
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-policy-engine-python
        with:
          profile: minimal

      - name: Check complete runtime schema snapshots
        run: uv run --extra ml python tools/quality/diagnostics/gen_schema.py --check

      - name: Generate current ABI snapshots
        run: uv run --extra ml python tools/quality/diagnostics/gen_schema.py --output-dir /tmp/current-schemas

      - name: Extract baseline snapshots from base branch
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p /tmp/baseline-schemas
          git archive --format=tar "${BASE_SHA}" policy-engine/schemas/snapshots 2>/dev/null | tar -xf - -C /tmp/baseline-schemas || true
          if [[ -d /tmp/baseline-schemas/policy-engine/schemas/snapshots ]]; then
            mv /tmp/baseline-schemas/policy-engine/schemas/snapshots/* /tmp/baseline-schemas/
            rm -rf /tmp/baseline-schemas/policy-engine
          fi
          mkdir -p /tmp/baseline-schemas/ir /tmp/baseline-schemas/fabric

      - name: Run ABI semantic diff
        id: abi_diff
        run: |
          set +e
          uv run python tools/quality/diagnostics/abi_diff.py \
            --baseline /tmp/baseline-schemas \
            --current /tmp/current-schemas \
            --output /tmp/abi-report.json \
            --format github \
            --github-comment /tmp/abi-comment.md
          diff_status=$?
          echo "diff_status=${diff_status}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          verdict=$(python3 -c "import json; print(json.load(open('/tmp/abi-report.json'))['verdict'])")
          echo "verdict=${verdict}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          exit 0

      - name: Upload ABI report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: abi-schema-report
          path: |
            /tmp/abi-report.json
            /tmp/abi-comment.md
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Fail on blocking ABI verdict
        if: steps.abi_diff.outputs.verdict == 'FAIL'
        run: |
          echo "::error::ABI gate failed. Breaking changes detected without a required schema_version major bump."
          exit 1

  fast-pr-gate:
    name: Fast PR / Gate
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
      - workflow-governance
      - dependency-review
      - quality-and-unit
      - docs-quality
      - abi-check
      - schema-snapshots
    steps:
      - name: Enforce fast tier
        env:
          RESULTS: ${{ join(needs.*.result, ',') }}
          SCHEMA_RESULT: ${{ needs.schema-snapshots.result }}
        run: |
          echo "Fast tier results: ${RESULTS}"
          if [[ "${SCHEMA_RESULT}" != "success" ]]; then
            echo "::error::Schema snapshot measurement did not complete successfully (${SCHEMA_RESULT})."
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ "${RESULTS}" == *"failure"* || "${RESULTS}" == *"cancelled"* ]]; then
            echo "::error::Fast PR gate failed."
            exit 1
          fi
